claims.quote: Type locality is 'Palembang, Sumatra, Indonesia', but this species is widely distributed throughout much of Southeast Asia including major river systems in Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, Vietnam and Peninsular Malaysia plus the Greater Sunda Islands of Sumatra, Borneo and Java.
